events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and secure data access
events.decision: Confirm access to finance, purchasing and inventory data and to site staff?
agenda: Present the diagnostic approach and the process areas in scope
Review the data and people access the diagnostic needs
Confirm the owners who will provide that access

events.label: Check-in: requirements
events.decision: Confirm the finance and purchasing requirements to carry into the sign-off pack?
agenda: Present the draft finance and purchasing requirements
Discuss gaps and open points in the draft requirements
Confirm what is still needed before the sign-off pack

events.label: Requirements sign-off
events.decision: Approve the requirements and go to vendor selection?
agenda: Present the requirements and fit-gap pack for sign-off
Review the fit-gap of current systems against requirements
Decide on the requirements and the move to vendor selection

events.label: Check-in: vendor scoring
events.decision: Confirm which scored vendors the business case covers for the selection gate?
agenda: Present the vendor shortlist against the signed-off requirements
Review the vendor scoring against the requirements
Confirm the vendors the business case will cover

events.label: Vendor selection
events.purpose: Select the ERP vendor for implementation
events.decision: Which ERP vendor goes forward into implementation?
agenda: Present the ERP business case with vendor scoring
Discuss how the vendors compare against the business case
Decide which ERP vendor goes forward into implementation

events.label: Check-in: configuration
events.decision: Confirm the finance and purchasing configuration as the base for migration rehearsals?
agenda: Present the tested configuration for finance and purchasing
Review test results and open issues
Confirm the base for the data migration rehearsals

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Check readiness before the pilot goes live
events.decision: Go or no-go to take the pilot site live, given configuration and migration readiness?
agenda: Present the tested inventory configuration and migration rehearsal results
Review readiness of configuration, data load checks and the pilot site
Decide whether the pilot site goes live

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot results
events.decision: Go or no-go to start the rollout waves, given the pilot stability log?
agenda: Present the pilot site go-live record and stability log
Review open issues and lessons for the other sites
Decide whether the rollout waves start

events.label: Check-in: first wave
events.purpose: Review first wave and acceptance path
events.decision: Confirm or adjust the remaining rollout waves given the first wave stability report?
agenda: Present the first rollout wave go-live and stability report
Review site coverage so far against the final acceptance criteria
Confirm or adjust the remaining rollout waves

events.label: Final acceptance
events.purpose: Decide on final acceptance of the ERP
events.decision: Approve the ERP as running in all 40 pharmacies and both warehouses?
agenda: Present the final acceptance pack with the go-live record by site
Review go-live status for each of the 40 pharmacies and both warehouses
Decide on final acceptance of the ERP
